message:
Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, staged loading over three days makes the daytime array fit without resizing.

Plainly the panels cover one staged day plus steady holding. The array need is about 8 kilowatt hours per day in the array sizing (E16), met by 2.2 kilowatts from four times 550 watt panels using the LVTOPSUN 550W Solar Panel (E4), under sun of 4.5 to 6.5 kilowatt hours per square metre per day in SOLAR IRRADIATION POTENTIAL OF AFRICA (E15), about one parking space of ten square metres beside the room so plausible.

Baraka, Chidi and Dalia, the night store covers the overnight half of that staged day with a proper controller.

Plainly half the daily use sleeps through the night on the battery. The store is 5.12 kilowatt hours in the EG4 LifePower4 48V 5.12kWh 100Ah Lithium Iron Phosphate Battery (E10), where Lithium Iron Phosphate means a long-life lithium chemistry, against about 4 kilowatt hours for a twelve hour night, about half a household day so plausible, switched by the 150 volt 60 ampere unit in the Victron BlueSolar MPPT 150/60-Tr Charge Controller - SCC010060200 (E7), where Maximum Power Point Tracking means extracting peak panel power.

I am not ready, because Baraka's upsized 1000 watt cooling peak changes my peak current and wiring size from the 315 watt steady in the steady load simulation (E31) and must be fixed with Chidi and Dalia.
